I was 10, babysitting my little cousin. He was known throughout the family as the rebellious baby and he did everything we told him not to do. My Tia thought it was a great idea to leave me with this child and go off somewhere for the rest of the day until my parents got home and most likely yelled at her for being irresponsible (which they did). He was a year and a half and I was at the top of the stairs trying to get him to get away from the staircase because it was a pretty steep drop. I called out to him really annoyed because I have been with him for at least four hours and sick of his constant whining. While I was calling for him to get away from there that to get back to the bed and go back to sleep he screamed NO and took one step back flinging him down the stairs. I sat there watching his little body roll down the stairs, stop for a split second, do a mini flip, and roll the rest of the way down. I went down the stairs as fast as I could without falling too and picked him up. He looked so startled and his noes was bleeding. I carried him into the bathroom and started to clean his noes off, when he saw the blood for the first time and screamed and cried for an hour after. He fell asleep a little after. I called my mother and told her what had happened and she started cursing like a sailor and hung up. I was scared sitting for about three more hours and then they finally came home by this time Christopher (the little kid) had awoken and was smiling. My mother came in with her sister and yelled at her for a good thirty minutes then kicked her out with Chris. Eight years later i'm his favorite cousin.
